subject: RM_Gorestalk
departures: columns made of soft, glistening, tube-like flesh like stood-up entrails, not woody or waxy plant skin
ring-shaped bulges and pinches running up each column, like the folds of a gut
deep visceral red all over, with no green anywhere
no spines, leaves, needles, flowers or branching arms; each column is a bare upright tube
tall columns packed close together into a solid wall you cannot see through
